strings.configconvertformat: If latex and dvips are present in addition to convert or dvisvgm, select the preferred image type (convert produces GIF or PNG; dvisvgm produces SVG). Otherwise mimeTeX will be used to to create GIF images.
strings.pathmimetexdesc: Moodle will use its own mimetex binary unless another valid path is specified.
strings.privacy:metadata: The TeX notation plugin does not store any personal data.
